030package dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources;
031
032import javax.sql.RowSet;
033import javax.sql.rowset.CachedRowSet;
034import javax.sql.rowset.FilteredRowSet;
035import javax.sql.rowset.JdbcRowSet;
036import javax.sql.rowset.JoinRowSet;
037import javax.sql.rowset.WebRowSet;
038
039/**
040 * Specifies specific things that are supported by SS.
041 * <p>
042 * Experimental, this class may go away.
043 */
044public interface SsSupport {
045  /**
046   * Does SS handle the specified type of RowSet.
047   * @param rs
048   * @return
049   */
050  default boolean isWritableRowSetType(RowSet rs) {
051    return switch (rs) {
052      case FilteredRowSet _ -> false;
053      case JoinRowSet _ -> false;
054      case WebRowSet _ -> false;
055      case JdbcRowSet _ -> true;
056      case CachedRowSet _ -> true;
057      default -> false;
058    };
059  }
060}
